title: orthochilus corymbosus
intro: Orthochilus corymbosus, commonly known as the bushy beardtongue, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various health issues such as wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Orthochilus corymbosus include its ability to stimulate the immune system and its potential to act as an antioxidant, which can help protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
